collection.name: Art Blockers
collection.description:
ART BLOCKERS is a generative pixel art collection of 1,111 unique identities by Raul Casillas.
Every Blocker begins as an original geometric identity constructed on a 32×32 pixel grid. These identities are then processed through a generative system controlling shape, algorithm, material, damage, motion, lighting and color.
Unlike traditional trait-based PFP collections, ART BLOCKERS does not build characters by simply swapping predefined traits. The algorithm transforms the underlying geometry itself.
Identity → Generative System → Final State
1,111 unique identities. One generative system. Infinite states.
